title: Chicken Curry

ingredients.name: chicken marinade
items: 500 grams curry cut chicken or use boneless thighs
1/4 cup - ginger, garlic and green chillies, finely chopped

ingredients.name: spices
items: 1 tbsp red chilli powder, 1/2 tsp haldi, 1 tbsp coriander powder, 1 tsp cumin powder,
1 tsp garam masala + 1 tsp kasturi methi
garnish: coriander, sliced ginger and green chilli

method: Marinate chicken in a bowl with all marinade ingredients and set aside till you need it ( max 12 hours ).
In a kadai, add ghee, whole spices, onions until translucent. Add ginger, garlic, green chillies, cook for 3-4 mins.
Lower heat, add powdered spices, splash of water, cook until ghee is released ( due to the lower nature of fat in this recipe, you might not see it as pronounced but it will take 3-4 minutes.
Add tomatoes, salt, cook for 8-10 mins. adjust water if too dry.
Lower flame, then add marinated chicken, stir gently for 2-3 mins. Increase heat, cook for 5-6 mins, then cover and cook for 10 mins.
Continue covering for 20-25 mins until chicken is tender. Add garam masala, kasuri methi, ginger, green chillies, stir.
To serve, either serve as is as it will be thick or add a cup of water and adjust consistency for a more curry as ive done
Serve with steamed basmati rice OR roti :)

Chicken Curry 
high protein | indian main course | meal prep friendly | under 60 minute recipe 

Nutrition Information: 
C: 21  F: 16 | P: 36
Calories: 323 per serve
Serves 3

Ingredients 
chicken marinade: 
500 grams curry cut chicken or use boneless thighs 
1/2 cup dahi, whisked till smooth 
1 tsp haldi
1 tsp red chili powder
1 tbsp ginger garlic paste

1 tbsp ghee + 1 tsp oil
1/2 tsp jeera
1/2 inch cinnamon
2 cloves
1 bay leaf
2 onions, finely chopped
1/4 cup - ginger, garlic and green chillies, finely chopped
spices:
 1 tbsp red chilli powder, 1/2 tsp haldi, 1 tbsp coriander powder, 1 tsp cumin powder, 
2 tomatoes, finely chopped
salt to taste

1 tsp garam masala + 1 tsp kasturi methi 
garnish: coriander, sliced ginger and green chilli

method 
marinate chicken in a bowl with all marinade ingredients and set aside till you need it ( max 12 hours ).
In a kadai, add ghee, whole spices, onions until translucent. Add ginger, garlic, green chillies, cook for 3-4 mins. 
lower heat, add powdered spices, splash of water, cook until ghee is released ( due to the lower nature of fat in this recipe, you might not see it as pronounced but it will take 3-4 minutes. 
add tomatoes, salt, cook for 8-10 mins. adjust water if too dry. 
lower flame, then add marinated chicken, stir gently for 2-3 mins. Increase heat, cook for 5-6 mins, then cover and cook for 10 mins. 
continue covering for 20-25 mins until chicken is tender. Add garam masala, kasuri methi, ginger, green chillies, stir. 

to serve, either serve as is as it will be thick or add a cup of water and adjust consistency for a more curry as ive done 

serve with steamed basmati rice OR roti :)
